aischeduler.title: AI Irrigation Scheduler
aischeduler.subtitle: Predictive planning utilizing weather patterns and renewable availability
aischeduler.empty: No upcoming schedules. Crops are at optimal moisture levels!
aischeduler.howBody: Our ML optimization model analyzes 7-day weather forecasts and local grid pricing. Pumps are scheduled to run when solar/wind generation is at its peak, storing excess power in battery banks, or shifting irrigation to cheaper off-peak grid hours.
aischeduler.safetyBody: If rainfall (precipitation > 5mm) is forecasted within the next 24 to 48 hours, the system delays pump runs to let rain naturally irrigate the fields, preventing water wastage and saving energy.
